"Active exploitation has been observed targeting the Palo Alto Networks management interface exposed to the internet," the network security company said in an update to its advisory. The vulnerabilities, tracked as
items.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-76418, is rated 8.6 on the CVSS scoring system. Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the
items.summary: Cisco patched a high-severity denial-of-service vulnerability in ASA and FTD software actively exploited in the wild. Network administrators and infrastructure teams are affected. Upgrade Cisco ASA and FTD software to the latest patched version.

items.title: GitHub Launches npm Firewall to Block Malicious Packages Before Installation
items.snippet: GitHub has announced that it's introducing a new package firewall as a preview to block installation of suspicious npm packages during installation time. "The firewall inspects both metadata requests and package downloads for signs of malicious activity, acting as an install-time policy gate," GitHub said. The feature, which currently supports only npm packages, is available in public preview
items.summary: GitHub introduced an npm firewall preview to block suspicious and malicious packages during installation. Node.js and JavaScript developers relying on npm are affected. Enable the npm firewall preview on your repositories.
items.bumpReason: Directly impacts npm supply chain security.

items.snippet: An attacker tried to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability on the Alpine Linux project's own GitLab server a week after GitLab released a fix, Alpine Linux said on 28 October. The flaw, CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS score: 10.0), can let an attacker run code on a GitLab server through a crafted regular expression in a CI configuration. Alpine found no evidence that the attack worked but
items.summary: An attacker attempted to exploit a critical CVSS 10.0 code execution flaw in GitLab caused by a Ruby regular expression issue on Alpine Linux's server. Developers and administrators managing GitLab instances are affected. Update GitLab to the latest patched version.

items.title: Telegram Android Flaw Lets Attackers Run Code When Users Answer Voice Calls
items.snippet: A flaw in Telegram for Android allowed an attacker to run code on a victim's phone via a voice call once the victim answered, according to security startup NebuSec. The attacker needed only an ordinary Telegram account. Telegram fixed the flaw in version 12.10.4 of the app, released in late September, and NebuSec disclosed it on October 29. The flaw can be triggered in every version from
items.summary: A remote code execution flaw in Telegram for Android allowed attackers to run code via voice calls. Android app users are affected. Upgrade Telegram to 12.10.4 or later.

items.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
items.snippet: 26,400 credentials that developers left in public code on Gitee, a Chinese code-hosting service, still worked when a researcher tested them. Anyone who copied one from that code could have used it. Independent researcher Ben Zimmermann found them by scanning 7.25 million public Gitee repositories and reported the results on October 28. Most were keys for cloud and AI services, led by
items.summary: Over 26,000 valid cloud and AI credentials were found exposed in public Gitee repositories. Developers using Gitee or managing those credentials are affected. Rotate any exposed credentials immediately.

items.title: decode-uri-component vulnerable to denial of service via quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs
items.snippet: `decodeUriComponent()` takes quadratic time on malformed input that has many distinct percent-encoded runs. A single unauthenticated request of about 224 KB can block the Node.js event loop for about 20 seconds. Version 0.5.0, the release that fixed CVE-2026-45822, is affected. When native decodeURIComponent throws, `decodeUriComponent()` falls back to `customDecodeURIComponent` (`index.js:122`).…
items.summary: decode-uri-component is vulnerable to a denial of service via quadratic replacement on malformed inputs, affecting Node.js developers. Upgrade decode-uri-component to 0.5.1 or later.

items.snippet: The contents of files that are specified by [`server.fs.deny`](https://vite.dev/config/server-options#server-fs-deny) can be returned to the browser. This is the same as https://github.com/vitejs/vite/security/advisories/GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r. Only apps that match the following conditions are affected: - explicitly exposes the Vite dev server to the network (using `--host` or [`server.host` config…
items.summary: Vite allows bypassing server.fs.deny restrictions via specific queries, affecting frontend web developers. Upgrade vite to 6.4.5 or later.

items.title: Cedar: JSON template is in scope missing slot-id validation allows link panic and decision divergence
items.snippet: Cedar users must be using all of the following features to be affected by this advisory: JSON format policies, policy templates, and the `is in` scope condition. This advisory only affects JSON-formatted Cedar policy templates containing `is in` scope conditions that are malformed according to the Cedar syntax. It does not affect syntactically well-formed policies. Users of Cedar who author polic…
items.summary: Cedar JSON templates containing is-in scope conditions can experience link panic and decision divergence due to missing slot-id validation. Upgrade cedar-policy and @cedar-policy/cedar-wasm to 4.11.1, 3.4.3 or later.

items.title: @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp: HTTP transport accepts unauthenticated requests despite a configured MCP_API_KEY
items.snippet: When `@sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp` is run as an HTTP server (`MCP_TRANSPORT=http`), it reads the `MCP_API_KEY` environment variable and logs `API key authentication enabled (X-API-Key header)` at startup, but it never validated the `X-API-Key` header on incoming requests. The key was read into a variable and never enforced on the request path. As a result, the `/mcp` endpoint accepted unauthenticated…
items.summary: @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp fails to validate X-API-Key headers on incoming HTTP transport requests, affecting developers using this Model Context Protocol server. Upgrade @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp to 3.0.1 or later.

items.title: Parse Server vulnerable to stored XSS via malformed Content-Type bypassing file upload extension blocklist
items.snippet: Parse Server's file upload validation uses the `fileUpload.fileExtensions` option (enabled by default with a blocklist) to reject files that browsers may render as active content, mitigating stored cross-site scripting (XSS). When an uploaded file's extension is not recognized by the `mime` package, Parse Server preserves the client-supplied `Content-Type` and passes it to the storage adapter. A…
items.summary: Parse Server is vulnerable to stored XSS via file uploads bypassing extension blocklists, affecting Node.js backend developers. Upgrade parse-server to 9.10.0-alpha.2, 8.6.84 or later.

items.title: PocketMine-MP has potential memory/network vulnerability from repeated ResourcePackClientResponsePacket packets
items.snippet: During the resource pack stage of logging in, after the server sends `ResourcePackStackPacket`, a malicious client can send a batch of multiple `ResourcePackClientResponsePacket` packets with status `ResourcePackClientResponsePacket::STATUS_COMPLETED` causing the server to repeatedly execute pre-spawn progression. Multiple `Player` objects can be created for just a single session, increasing memo…
items.summary: PocketMine-MP is vulnerable to memory and network resource exhaustion from repeated resource pack response packets, affecting PHP game server administrators. Upgrade pocketmine/pocketmine-mp to 5.44.2 or later.

items.title: MultiFactor Authentication for SilverStripe can bypass MFA during password reset flow
items.snippet: In CMS 5, the password reset flow let a user with multi-factor authentication enabled change their password and get a logged-in session before completing multi-factor authentication. Exploiting this requires access to the user's email account. CMS 6 is not affected.
items.summary: SilverStripe MFA can be bypassed during password reset flows in CMS 5, affecting PHP developers using SilverStripe. Upgrade silverstripe/mfa to 6.0.0 or later.

items.title: Twisted: Unauthenticated Remote Denial of Service in the Twisted HTTP/2 Server via Rapid Stream Reset
items.snippet: An uncontrolled-resource-consumption vulnerability (CWE-400) in the Twisted HTTP/2 server lets any unauthenticated remote client exhaust server CPU over a single connection. A client that sends a request header block with `END_STREAM` and then immediately resets the stream makes the server route and render the request before it processes the reset. Reset streams are freed and never count against…
items.summary: Twisted HTTP/2 server is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote denial of service via rapid stream resets, affecting Python developers. Upgrade Twisted to 26.10.0rc1 or later.

items.title: PraisonAI vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via Broken AST Sandbox
items.snippet: JobWorkflowExecutor._exec_inline_python() is designed to safely execute inline Python expressions from YAML workflow script: steps using AST validation. The function claims to block dangerous operations by (a) checking all AST nodes against an allowlist, and (b) providing a builtins whitelist that omits import, exec, eval, and open. The sandbox is broken. The module import allowlist (allowed_modu…
items.summary: PraisonAI is vulnerable to remote code execution due to a broken AST sandbox in inline Python execution, affecting AI workflow developers. Upgrade praisonai to 4.6.78 or later.

items.summary: A high-severity TCP flaw in the Linux kernel affects major distributions like Ubuntu and Red Hat, with a working AI-generated exploit demonstrated. Upgrade your Linux kernel via your distribution package manager.
